Commands.Name: Disk - Free space on C:
Commands.Description: Read only. Shows free space in GB; useful before and after cleanup.
Commands.Command: (Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DeviceID='C:'").FreeSpace / 1GB

Commands.Name: Disk - Largest folders on C:
Commands.Description: Read only, but potentially slow. Inaccessible files are omitted from size estimates.
Commands.Command: Get-ChildItem C:\ -Directory | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ Folder=$_.FullName; GB=[math]::Round(((Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum / 1GB), 2) } } | Sort-Object GB -Descending

Commands.Name: Cleanup - Windows temporary files
Commands.Description: Deletes contents of the Windows Temp folder, not the folder itself. Locked or inaccessible items are reported.
Commands.Command:
$tempFolder = Join-Path $env:windir 'Temp'
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $tempFolder -Force -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Continue }

Commands.Name: Cleanup - Crash dump files
Commands.Description: Deletes MEMORY.DMP and files in Minidump. This removes evidence needed for crash investigations.

Commands.Name: Cleanup - Windows.old
Commands.Description: Destructive. Removes the previous Windows installation and rollback files. Changes ownership and permissions first; review before running.

Commands.Name: Profiles - Preview profiles to remove (edit first)
Commands.Description: Read only. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PROFILE_FOLDER with the primary user's profile folder name. Special and loaded profiles are excluded. Review this list before using the removal command.

Commands.Name: Profiles - Remove unused profiles (edit first)
Commands.Description: Destructive: deletes profile data. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PROFILE_FOLDER with the primary user's profile folder name and run the matching preview first. Special and loaded profiles are excluded.

Commands.Name: Cleanup - User temporary files
Commands.Description: Deletes Temp contents under each profile in C:\Users. Locked or inaccessible items are reported.

Commands.Name: Cleanup - Windows Update download cache
Commands.Description: Disruptive. Stops Windows Update and BITS, clears downloaded updates, and restores each service's original running/stopped state. Do not use during an active update.

Commands.Name: Servicing - Analyze component store
Commands.Description: Read only. DISM analyzes component-store usage; this may take several minutes.
Commands.Command:
DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /AnalyzeComponentStore
if ($LASTEXITCODE -notin @(0,3010)) { throw "DISM failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }

Commands.Name: Servicing - Standard component cleanup
Commands.Description: Changes the component store. Runs standard DISM cleanup; this may take several minutes.
Commands.Command:
DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup
if ($LASTEXITCODE -notin @(0,3010)) { throw "DISM failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }

Commands.Name: Servicing - Aggressive component cleanup (ResetBase)
Commands.Description: Irreversible. ResetBase prevents uninstalling existing update packages afterward. Use only after reviewing the impact.
Commands.Command:
DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup /ResetBase
if ($LASTEXITCODE -notin @(0,3010)) { throw "DISM failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }

Commands.Name: System - Windows version and build
Commands.Description: Read only. Shows product name, display version, build and revision.
Commands.Command:
$cv = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion'
"{0} {1} (Build {2}.{3})" -f $cv.ProductName,$cv.DisplayVersion,$cv.CurrentBuild,$cv.UBR

Commands.Name: System - Uptime
Commands.Description: Read only. Shows elapsed time since the last Windows boot.
Commands.Command:
$u=(Get-Date)-(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime
"{0} days, {1} hours, {2} minutes" -f $u.Days,$u.Hours,$u.Minutes

Commands.Name: Upgrade - Remove failed upgrade staging files
Commands.Description: Destructive. Removes C:\$WINDOWS.~BT after a failed or cancelled upgrade, including setup diagnostics. Do not run during an active upgrade; review before retrying setup.

Commands.Name: Repair - Scan and repair Windows system files
Commands.Description: Runs SFC /scannow, which can repair protected system files. May take several minutes; review SFC output.
Commands.Command: sfc /scannow

Commands.Name: Intune - Start the PushLaunch scheduled task
Commands.Description: Starts the existing PushLaunch task on the endpoint. Task start does not prove a completed Intune sync.
Commands.Command: Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'PushLaunch' -ErrorAction Stop | Start-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction Stop

Commands.Name: Reboot - Pending reboot check
Commands.Description: Read only. Returns True if common servicing, Windows Update or file-rename reboot flags are present.
Commands.Command: (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending') -or (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\RebootRequired') -or ((Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).PendingFileRenameOperations -ne $null)

Commands.Name: Reboot - Reasons a reboot is pending
Commands.Description: Read only. Lists common pending-reboot reasons; no output means none of these flags were found.

Commands.Name: Reboot - Detailed reboot status
Commands.Description: Read only. Shows common pending-reboot flags separately.

Commands.Name: Reboot - Pending file renames
Commands.Description: Read only. Lists pending file rename operations from Session Manager.
Commands.Command: (Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager' -ErrorAction Stop).PendingFileRenameOperations

Commands.Name: Servicing - Pending CBS registry keys
Commands.Description: Read only. Lists servicing registry keys containing Pending or Reboot.
Commands.Command:
Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing' |
Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -match 'Pending|Reboot' } |
Select-Object PSChildName

Commands.Name: Updates - Recently installed hotfixes
Commands.Description: Read only. Lists hotfix IDs and installation dates, newest first.
Commands.Command: Get-HotFix | Select-Object HotFixID,InstalledOn | Sort-Object InstalledOn -Descending

Commands.Name: Updates - Recent Windows Update errors
Commands.Description: Read only. Filters errors from the most recent 100 Windows Update operational events.
Commands.Command:
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient/Operational' -MaxEvents 100 |
Where-Object { $_.Level -eq 2 } |
Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,Message

Commands.Name: Updates - Recent update and servicing activity
Commands.Description: Read only. Filters Windows Update and servicing entries from the most recent 100 System events.
Commands.Command:
Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 100 |
Where-Object { $_.ProviderName -match 'WindowsUpdate|Servicing' } |
Select-Object TimeCreated,ProviderName,Id,Message

Commands.Name: Servicing - Pending CBS packages
Commands.Description: Read only. Shows PackagesPending registry properties. A missing key is reported as an error.
Commands.Command: Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\PackagesPending' -ErrorAction Stop | Format-List *

Commands.Name: Reboot - Windows Update reboot registry key
Commands.Description: Read only. Shows the Windows Update RebootRequired key. A missing key is reported as an error.
Commands.Command: Get-Item 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\RebootRequired' -ErrorAction Stop

Commands.Name: Installer - Recent MSI activity
Commands.Description: Read only. Filters MSI installer entries from the most recent 100 Application events.
Commands.Command:
Get-WinEvent -LogName Application -MaxEvents 100 |
Where-Object { $_.ProviderName -eq 'MsiInstaller' } |
Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,Message

Commands.Name: Disk - Upgrade artifact sizes
Commands.Description: Read only, but potentially slow. Estimates sizes of root items whose names start with $. Inaccessible files are omitted.
Commands.Command: Get-ChildItem C:\ -Force | Where-Object Name -like '$*' | Select-Object Name,@{N='GB';E={"{0:N2}" -f ((Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum/1GB)}}
